question_text: Find the maximum or minimum value of 2x − 7 − 5x², where x ∈ R.

The correct maximum is −34/5: at x = 1/5 the expression is 2/5 − 7 − 1/5 = −34/5, and since a = −5 < 0 with Δ = 4 − 140 < 0 the expression is negative for every x, so a positive maximum is impossible. recall_prompt: Say how you would find the maximum or minimum value — say what decides which one it is, and what formula gives the value.
insider_note: Rewrite in descending powers first: a = −5, so there is a maximum. Expect that maximum itself to be negative — the whole expression sits below the axis, and 'correcting' the sign at the end is the standard lost mark.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Sign of a
steps.margin_note: First mark. Rewrite in descending powers first: −5x² + 2x − 7, so a = −5, b = 2, c = −7. a < 0 means the graph opens downward, so there is a highest point and no lowest — a MAXIMUM.
lines: a = −5 < 0, so the expression has a

recall.must_convey: That a, b, c are read off as −5, 2, −7, and that a < 0 means the expression has a maximum value, not a minimum.
accept: compare with a x squared plus b x plus c, a is minus five which is negative so it has a maximum
a is negative so the expression has a greatest value and no least value
only the sign of a matters, a equals minus five less than zero means maximum
a negative kabatti maximum untundi, minimum undadu
a is minus five b is two c is minus seven and a negative gives a maximum

steps.why: The expression is written out of order to test whether a is read correctly. Whether a maximum or a minimum exists depends only on the sign of a: negative a opens downward and has a highest point, so only a maximum exists.
common_mistakes: Deciding 'minimum' from the constant −7 being negative — only a matters.

steps.label: Value
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Maximum = (4ac − b²)/(4a) = (4(−5)(−7) − 4)/(−20) = 136/(−20) = −34/5. The maximum value is NEGATIVE: the whole expression is below the axis (a < 0 and b² − 4ac = 4 − 140 < 0), so its highest point is still negative. The maximum occurs at x = −b/2a = 1/5.

recall.must_convey: That the maximum value is (4ac − b²)/(4a) = (140 − 4)/(−20) = −34/5, a negative number.
accept: the maximum is four a c minus b squared over four a which is one hundred forty minus four over minus twenty equals minus thirty four by five
substitute into four a c minus b squared by four a to get minus thirty four by five
one thirty six over minus twenty is minus thirty four by five
four a c minus b square by four a lo pettithe minus thirty four by five vasthundi
maximum value minus thirty four by five
heard_as: four a c minus b squared

steps.why: Completing the square gives a(x + b/2a)² + (4ac − b²)/(4a); with a < 0 the squared term only lowers the value, so (4ac − b²)/(4a) is the greatest value. Here 4ac = (−5)(−7)·4 = +140 — two negatives multiply to a positive.
common_mistakes: Dropping the minus sign and answering 34/5 — a negative expression cannot have a positive maximum.
Answering x = 1/5 (where the maximum occurs) instead of the maximum value.
